summary: Lanvin Group Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing its 2025 full-year results presentation and earnings press release. The filing includes forward-looking statements and incorporates by reference several registration statements (Forms F-3 and F-1). No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change is disclosed. The registrant is Lanvin Group, a foreign private issuer based in China; this is a routine earnings report.
